INVESTMENT PHILOSOPHY

PRINCIPAL INVESTORS: Coulton Creek was founded as a vehicle to generate current
returns for a group of five experienced investors. From inception, founders and key
employees have invested their own capital in each investment, which has guided our
perspective for each opportunity and has created exceptional alignment with our
investors.
Today, Coulton Creek manages approximately 60 positions for our founders and
investors, with the original five founding principals investing in every deal and serving as
the investment committee.
PRESERVATION OF PRINCIPAL: As principal investors, we prioritize preservation of
principal and downside protection. We take a conservative approach to underwriting that
reflects having our own skin in the game, and often seek a priority position in the capital
stack.
CURRENT RETURNS: With a dedicated focus on generating strong current returns for
our investors, Coulton Creek seeks resilient assets which are less sensitive to volatile
market swings and resulting valuations.
RETURN OBJECTIVES: As an opportunistic investor without a need to deploy
committed capital (in contrast to many funds), Coulton Creek can be selective in finding
those investments which deliver superior risk adjusted returns.
LEADERSHIP

Chris Hanks – Managing Director
Chris co-founded Coulton Creek Capital in 2013 and has led the company in deploying over
$277 million of direct investments, building a diversified portfolio of private real estate equity and
debt. Today, Chris leads the Coulton Creek team setting the strategic direction for the firm, as
well guiding investment decisions for Coulton Creek.
Before Coulton Creek, Chris was the CFO and COO of HealthTrans, a privately held pharmacy
benefit manager. At HealthTrans, Chris helped grow revenue from $4 million to $300 million and
raised $100 million in debt and equity to fund acquisitions and a minority recapitalization. Chris
concluded his tenure with the company’s $250 million sale in January 2012.

Will Hensley – Director
Will joined Coulton Creek Capital as the third employee in 2015. During his tenure, Will has
been involved in almost every aspect of Coulton Creek. In his current role as Director, Will is
responsible for sourcing new investment opportunities, as well as underwriting, due diligence
and portfolio management duties.
Prior to joining Coulton Creek, Will worked in commercial banking where he acquired a diverse
skill set included underwriting and portfolio management, as well as experience and oversight of
distressed real estate assets.

Scott Brown – Director
Scott joined Coulton Creek Capital as a Director in 2022. Scott is responsible for sourcing and
underwriting new real estate investment opportunities as well as assisting in portfolio
management and investor relations responsibilities.
Prior to joining Coulton Creek, Scott worked at Real Capital Solutions, a Colorado-based real
estate family office. Scott served as a member of RCS’ Investment Committee evaluating the
risks, cash flows, capital requirements, deal structuring, and the overall status of RCS’ portfolio.
